title: FIELD SKETCH - blind-c-storage (storage room)
anchor: pen 15'-0" south wall = 12" + 13'-0" + 12" heater chain on north wall
interpretations: Job name taken from the sketch title block 'FIELD SKETCH - blind-c-storage'; no job name is stated elsewhere.

Room read as a plain 15'-0" x 12'-2" rectangle. The jog drawn on the east side (short horizontal line into the room at the bottom of the 3'-11" segment) is read as the door leaf drawn open into the room, not as a wall notch: the gap in the east wall scales to ~3'-0", matching the 'DR 3'-0"' callout, and both side walls carry the same 12'-2" dimension.

Runs are ordered clockwise from the NW corner (E north wall, S east wall, W south wall, N west wall) so the door's stated dimension - 3'-11" from the NE corner to the near jamb - can be entered directly as 'at' on the east-wall run without derived arithmetic. The unstated wall segment below the door (12'-2" - 3'-11" - 3'-0" = 5'-3") is implied by closure, never entered.

'13'-0" CLEAR BETWEEN HEATERS' is the clear width between the two heaters, NOT the north wall length. North wall recorded as the chain 12" + 13'-0" + 12" = 15'-0", which matches the pen 15'-0" on the south wall exactly - this is the clear-width trap the format exists for.
'HTR 12" x 10"' read as 12" long along the wall by 10" deep into the room, matching the drawn proportions of both dashed boxes (wider than deep).

Heaters placed flush to the NW and NE corners (from 0" and from 14'-0"): the chain 12" + 13'-0" + 12" sums exactly to the 15'-0" wall, leaving no room between heater and corner, and the boxes are drawn touching the corners. The east heater's 'from' (14'-0") is chain arithmetic (12" + 13'-0"), not a lone pen number.
Door hinge recorded 'near': the leaf is drawn swinging from the jamb at the 3'-11" end of the opening (the near jamb as dimensioned from the NE corner).
Door height is not on the plan; 'h' omitted so it builds 80" flagged DEFAULT per the format.
Wall thickness and sill are not on the plan; fields omitted so house defaults (4" / 48") apply. No windows are drawn.
Pen note '* heaters stay - do not remove' carried into room notes.
